scope: Pre-measurement source-reviewed configuration, not a corpus-tuned or experimentally proven global optimum. Source review precedes preflight; invalid setup/readback is corrected during smoke. Performance settings are frozen for publishable noise and main passes.

host.policy: One benchmark target alive, one newswest.frugalusenet.com provider at port563 with verified TLS, pool ceiling10. GOMAXPROCS/DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT2; bounded memory. Parent rejects sampled process-tree oversubscription and overlapping consumers, including unknown local newswest consumers during a target run. Two clean-start passes measure noise; existing production and remote account consumers remain untouched.

zurg.pool: connections10 is the account-wide pool; interactive reads, background repair and speculative read-ahead share it. warm_connections2 is INSIDE the10, not an extra pool; idle drop120s. No further providers.
zurg.pipeline: Depth4 matches upstream measured flattening; cap8, adaptive fall-back1 for tearing. Batch byte ceiling16MiB keeps large article batches at minimum3. Do not pin socket_receive_buffer_kb; leave Linux receive autotuning active.
zurg.cache: Decoded article cache256MiB (rather than512 default), mmap segment metadata rather than resident arrays; PAR2 patch cache512MiB on isolated disk. memory_limit_mb1024 is soft GC ceiling, not OOM hard limit; allows metadata/solver/transient batch headroom.
zurg.repair: enable_repair true. Keep native missing-article/PAR2 behavior, never disable repair to improve rates. Preserve reparable patches until task reset.
zurg.background_import: Watch5s to retain real import latency. No media integrations/indexers, ffprobe auto-analysis or managed rclone mount; benchmarks use actual WebDAV. Native archive probing/read-ahead retained; no implementation changes.
zurg.readback: Dashboard /config reports repair/mmap/patch cache/rclone/watch settings, but not NNTP pool tuning. Rendered NNTP config plus startup log and parent runtime socket guard must supplement API readback.

altmount.pool: Single provider max_connections10 shared across import/stream/health/PAR2. min_connections_alive2 inside cap; pool idle120s. inflight_requests10 is body memory ceiling not10 extra sockets; stat_inflight_requests100 is bodyless pipeline not socket count. Health max_concurrent_segment_checks10 is renamed current field (old max_connections_for_health_checks was misleading).
altmount.pipeline_prefetch: Retain inflight10 provider default; actual pool-wide import budget/adaptive depth normally3-4. max_prefetch60 has upstream96MB ceiling; no deep stream override that sacrifices sequential speed. At most2 concurrent imports on2 CPUs; sampling1% is upstream import default and existing correctness tier remains unchanged.
altmount.cache: Memory segment cache256MiB; disk segment tier disabled to avoid synchronous write-amplification on shared host. Soft memory_limit_mb1024 with adaptive cache shrink rather than hard allocation failure. PAR2 solver256MiB spills oversized jobs to mmap scratch instead of refusing them.
altmount.repair: NEW current par2_repair.enabled true is essential: health.repair controls Arr rescans, NOT PAR2. max_connections10 shares background lane (quarter of pool while streaming/importing), max_concurrent_jobs1, repair_on_import true, max_repair_ratio1.0 so benchmark does not trim native correctness by default2% ratio ceiling. Unlimited release sizes; redundancy remains hard repair bound.
altmount.background: Health enabled60s; retains corruption detection without5s sweep noise; Arr/mount/SAB integrations disabled since harness imports through native API. No failure-masking hidden-file shortcuts. Explicit loopback api.allowed_origins is required: upstream's wildcard default plus credentialed CORS panics at startup.
altmount.isolation: Current queue uses filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), .altmount-queue), so executable wrapper sets TMPDIR to BENCH/altmount/tmp; reset retires only this directory, never global/tmp. Metadata, log, patch and memory-cache state task-owned.
altmount.readback: GET /api/config, checking all rendered exposed fields (secret values skipped). ConfigManager accepts max_concurrent_imports2 but ImportAPIResponse omits it; retain the configured cap and validate the API projection rather than inventing a returned value. The captured real API fixture records this distinction.

infinidysk.pool: One pooled provider MaxConnections10 plus MaxTransferConnections10; global download10 and queue10 admission caps all use same underlying pool. Repair fetch_concurrency2 and health concurrency2 are bounded lanes within pool, not separate accounts/pools. Keepalive warm floor2 inside10, idle120s. No live provider config rebuild during tests.
infinidysk.pipeline_prefetch: Enable queue pipelining with depth4 (default off/depth8); streaming pipelined BODY enabled with batch width4 default. Article buffer40 segment default kept; shared streams32MiB rings default kept for reuse/read-start behavior. Explicit host-wide in-flight article budget256MiB avoids deriving huge budget from host RAM; queue workers2.
infinidysk.cache: Disk segment-cache disabled (fresh upstream default), because shared-stream rings/header cache already retain useful hot bytes without synchronous disk writes. GC heap cap0x60000000=1.5GiB allows256MiB article budget, rings and solver, with additional native/runtime RSS outside heap.
infinidysk.repair: Master repair and PAR2 enabled,256MiB solver, fetch concurrency2; max-release-gb200 and max-missing-slices64 are source-supported maxima rather than default16GiB/8slice restrictions that trim correctness. Health workers1/concurrency2 retain STANDARD depth. Native lazy RAR remains default true, with eager fallback for unsupported solid/compressed/multifile shapes; ensure-importable-video preserved.
infinidysk.background: No configured Arr/indexer/media integration. Default weekly health/action schedule remains always-eligible; no blanket health/repair disabling to hide failures.
infinidysk.readback: POST /api/get-config repeated config-keys and x-api-key; authoritative ENV values shown via ConfigManager.GetEffectiveConfigValue, provider/password masked. All nonsecret effective keys compared.

nzbdav-og.pool: Provider MaxConnections10 hard underlying pool; usenet.max-download-connections10 avoids historical defaultmin(pool,15) ambiguity. Queue/import and streaming share pool. No exposed independent queue cap/warm/pipeline settings in this revision. Idle30s default is implementation-fixed; no unsupported config knobs fabricated.
nzbdav-og.prefetch_cache: Keep article-buffer-size40 default, streaming-priority80 default; no native configurable article disk cache or pipeline-depth knob. Bound managed heap1.5GiB and processors2 via .NET env, not source modifications.
nzbdav-og.repair: Original upstream has no PAR2 payload reconstruction setting. Its PAR2 parsing/deobfuscation is not recovery; enabling imaginary repair keys would misrepresent behavior. Keep ensure-importable-video default true and native archive probe unchanged; grade original correctness rather than shim it.
nzbdav-og.database: Official binary --db-migration on --network none creates NEW empty round master, exits before configManager/NNTP/server startup. Reset uses SQLite backup API from that task-owned pristine master, never production DB. Parameterized upserts then committed readback/integrity/root-count validation. Preserve exactly five migration-seeded root rows and zero release rows; never wholesale-delete DavItems.
nzbdav-og.readback: POST /api/get-config plus config-keys, api-key auth; provider/download cap and configured numeric values checked; no credentials logged.

decypharr.pool: Provider max_connections10 bounds all sockets; usenet.max_connections10 and processing_max_connections10 are per-file scheduling limits, not additive pools. Repair NNTP20% creates2 shared STAT workers using SAME provider pool. Repair workers2/max_active_downloads2 fit CPUs.
decypharr.pipeline_prefetch: BODY has no user pipeline-depth setting in this revision; STAT batching is native. read_ahead32MB explicit (default16MB) provides a few throughput windows at10 connections while aggregate buffer_memory256MB prevents multiplying RAM by active files. Native reader retains256MiB per-stream disk cap and cache semantics.
decypharr.cache_idle: All streams stored BENCH/decyrun/streams; shared buffer aggregate256MiB. conn_idle_timeout2m retains pooled sessions across playback gaps. Explicit socket read/write buffer0 preserves Linux autotuning instead of upstream4MB/1MB pinned socket options (no host sysctl edits). No DFS/rclone mount needed: harness consumes native WebDAV directly.
decypharr.repair_background: Managed source avoids nonexistent Arr-only repair source;5m schedule,1m recheck, auto_repair true; existing correctness outcomes not hidden. Current parser skips PAR2 files, so sweep/reacquisition is not PAR2 payload recovery; no nonexistent recovery toggle added. Archive probing and default1% import/10% repair sampling preserved.
decypharr.readback: GET /api/config checks rendered effective fields excluding secrets. Parent should set GOMAXPROCS2; Go runtime heap not given an artificially tiny limit that would cause persistent GC under native file buffers.

aiostreams.pool: One enabled TLS provider, maxConnections10, pipelineDepth4. The ten-slot provider worker pool is shared by filesystem imports, census and streaming through the warm engine registry. Do not invoke the dashboard provider-test endpoint: it creates a separate engine. Dialing is demand-driven; idle work has a fixed75% command budget (30 at depth4). The smoke peak was8 with allowance10; unused sockets are not padded artificially.
aiostreams.pipeline_prefetch: Custom profile: forty command slots (ten sockets times depth4), prefetch20, inspect concurrency4, census shadow12, streaming priority0.8. Upstream documents read-ahead beyond roughly twice the connection count as extra buffer depth and seek refetch/memory cost rather than throughput; twenty fits this ten-socket run instead of blindly using the high profile's sixty-four. Work admissions share ten sockets, not additive pools.
aiostreams.cache: Retain the upstream high profile's 8GB disk segment cache to support sequential reads and repeated seeks; all cache/SQLite/NZB state lives inside the isolated data directory and is retired between complete passes. Disk/cache costs are charged to this target, not hidden.
aiostreams.repair: No Reed-Solomon/PAR2 payload reconstruction implementation. PAR2 descriptors recover filenames only; article CRC verification, strict damage policy and native Matroska hole padding remain enabled. Hole padding is not parity repair.
aiostreams.background: Census verification enabled without an import-blocking verification budget. Periodic library rechecks off; census work still shares the pool. Lazy archive resolution retained. Native WebDAV enabled, FUSE/NFS off because the benchmark directly consumes the real WebDAV media tree.
aiostreams.interface: WebDAV Basic usenet:usenet; native /webdav/usenet/content/; SAB multipart nzbfile at /api/v1/sabnzbd/api with apikey=usenet:usenet. Omitted category places sanitized NZB stems directly under content.
aiostreams.readback: Validate rendered private env, pinned image revision and actual SAB import/PROPFIND/Range behavior under the runtime socket gate; health alone does not establish filesystem support.

verification_status: Pinned builds and isolated migration/reset complete on zen. A clean all-seven smoke served matching sampled plain-video bytes with 344 socket samples; six targets peaked at10, AIOStreams at8. Two clean-start noise passes and all70 main matrix rows completed on 2026-10-02. The publishable gate recorded5106 samples,4342 in the main window; every target reached10 in main, no sampled excess, overlap or unknown local newswest consumer. Actual median/max timestamp gaps3/15s, not continuous coverage. Positive byte consensus95/95. Worst clean-start rate swing67.8%; no global performance optimum or overall speed winner inferred. Known hole remained zero-filled or truncated, despite native repair settings. Compiler/base tags are not immutable digest locks; foreign workloads and regular zurg.service remained untouched.
